audit_items.proof_trace: Sui's on-chain VRF (`sui::random::new_generator`) provides cryptographically unpredictable randomness; the 36^6 ≈ 2.2B code space satisfies the collision_prob < 1/36^6 assertion. Minor modulo bias from `u8 % 36` (256 not divisible by 36) creates a ~14% relative bias on 4 of 36 characters per position, but does not materially change the collision probability or enable practical prediction. Collision is detected and rejected at L170 (`assert!(!self.code_owner.contains(referral_code))`), preventing duplicate codes.
